name: Carousel
author: byo-pop
description: A game mode: the board is a ring of 60 cells around a hub, and the only move is a twist. Click where four gems meet to turn them clockwise; a right click turns them the other way. Runs count on the diagonals too, for a little bonus, nine kinds of gem keep it from being easy, and power gems help: a run of 4 makes a flame gem, a run of 5 a lightning gem. Gems fall past the hub. The game ends when no twist makes a match. Uses its own high-score table.
